description: For unary relations \(P,Q\), unary function \(f\), and constant \(a\), the clauses \(\{P(x_0)\}\), \(\{\neg P(f(x_0)),Q(x_0)\}\), and \(\{\neg Q(a)\}\) have a generalized first-order resolution refutation.
signature:

    {Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.workedC P, Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.workedD P Q f,
      Lemmatheca.Entry.FirstOrderResolution.workedF Q a}
